summary: Design Templates Visual Differentiation - All 20 tests PASSED. Backend testing confirmed: 6 templates returned with distinct headerStyle (solid/rounded/minimal/neon/gradient/elegant), cornerRadius, fonts (heading/body), and unique accent colors. _build_header_bar function generates 6 distinctly different HTML outputs based on style. _style_content_html and _style_summary_html properly apply heading fonts to h1/h2/h3 and body fonts to paragraphs/lists. Session config correctly saves designTemplateId. Image elements receive cornerRadius from template.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Design template visual differentiation fix has been verified. Key findings: 1) GET /api/agent/design-templates returns 6 templates with correct structure including headerStyle, cornerRadius, fonts.heading, fonts.body, and unique palette colors. 2) _build_header_bar function generates 6 distinctly different HTML outputs - solid uses accent background, rounded has bottom border-radius, minimal has thin border only, neon has text-shadow and box-shadow effects, gradient uses linear-gradient, elegant has vertical accent bar. 3) _style_content_html applies heading font to h1/h2/h3 and body font to p/li elements. 4) Session config saves designTemplateId and passes to course generation. 5) Image elements receive cornerRadius from template palette.

GET /api/agent/design-templates.details: Returns 6 templates with id, name, description, preview (gradient), palette (primary/accent/contentBg/text), fonts (heading/body), headerStyle (solid/rounded/minimal/neon/gradient/elegant), cornerRadius (4px-16px)

_build_header_bar function.details: Each headerStyle produces distinctly different HTML: solid=accent background, rounded=bottom corners, minimal=thin border only, neon=glow effects, gradient=linear gradient, elegant=vertical bar

_style_content_html function.details: Applies fontHeading to h1/h2/h3 tags, fontBody to p/li tags, wraps content in div with body font

_style_summary_html function.details: Applies fontHeading to h1/h2 tags, fontBody to p/li tags

Session config designTemplateId.details: POST /api/agent/sessions/{id}/configure saves designTemplateId, get_design_template_by_id returns correct template or educacional fallback

cornerRadius on images.details: _build_content_slide applies cornerRadius from palette to image element style.borderRadius

header_styles_comparison.rounded: border-radius:0 0 16px 16px; margin effect with rounded bottom corners
header_styles_comparison.minimal: border-bottom:2px solid {accent}40; text colored with accent, no background
header_styles_comparison.neon: background:{primary}; text-shadow and box-shadow glow effects
header_styles_comparison.elegant: background:{primary}; 3px accent border bottom with 4x24px vertical accent bar
